reason: The README consistently describes a vision plugin that accepts images, performs OCR and visual analysis through local or remote VLM channels, and feeds structured evidence back into a text-only DeepSeek workflow.

summaries.zh: 为纯文本模型提供图片理解、OCR、区域分析和多图对比能力，并支持本地或兼容 API 的视觉模型通道。
summaries.en: Adds image understanding, OCR, region analysis, and multi-image comparison to text-only models through local or API-compatible vision backends.

capabilities: Accepts pasted images and local image paths for visual analysis
Sends image data to configured Gemini or OpenAI-compatible endpoints
Can use a local Ollama vision model
Provides an agent-invokable vision tool and an HTTP vision endpoint
Stores visual analysis results in the conversation timeline and reuses them across turns
Caches repeated image-analysis requests in process memory
